test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

She will __probably__ come tonight for a party.
solution:
The correct answer is: **definitely**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**probably**' suggests uncertainty or doubt. (अनिश्चितता या संदेह)

 
 
• **For example- ***I will probably go to the store later today.*
